requirements.evidence: All contract pieces present: enum CallMode (app/Enums/CallMode.php:6-10), NoWaitingTicketsException extends RuntimeException (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:8), invokable CallNextTicket::__invoke(Queue, User, CallMode = CallMode::Any) (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:16-20). Only waiting tickets of the queue (CallNextTicket.php:64-66), deterministic ordering priority desc/issued_at/id (CallNextTicket.php:79-80), mode filters (CallNextTicket.php:68-80), fairness on last 3 called by called_at then id with normal-waiting guard (CallNextTicket.php:40-61), inactive queue re-read and locked inside the transaction (CallNextTicket.php:24-31), dedicated exception when none eligible (CallNextTicket.php:102), exactly-once lock-and-recheck loop (CallNextTicket.php:82-100), and called_at/called_by_user_id set on return (CallNextTicket.php:94-99). Both required docs updated (docs/business-rules.md:102-112, docs/architecture.md:133-138).

conventions.evidence: Domain write correctly lives in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php (conventions.md:42-45) and docs are kept in sync for business-rules/architecture (conventions.md:92-103). But conventions.md:14-18 requires 'No production code without a test' and every implemented feature to ship with a test, and the diff contains no tests at all. CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] is also not updated (conventions.md:103), and the public __invoke has no PHPDoc (conventions.md:102).

security.evidence: No Livewire/HTTP surface introduced and authorization is explicitly out of scope (task.md:11-12, 64-66). DB state is re-read under lockForUpdate instead of trusting the passed model (CallNextTicket.php:24-31), inputs are typed (CallMode enum) and only status/called_at/called_by_user_id are assigned to the model (CallNextTicket.php:94-99), so no mass-assignment or client-trust weakness is visible.

tests.evidence: The diff touches only app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php, app/Enums/CallMode.php, app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php and two docs; no test file is added or modified. New behavior (ordering, modes, fairness streak, inactive queue, exactly-once recheck, no-ticket exception) is entirely untested.

simplicity.evidence: Single action class with no service/repository layer, direct Eloquent queries, three focused helper queries for the fairness history, and the minimum lock-and-recheck loop (CallNextTicket.php:21-104). No speculative abstraction or duplication.

readability.evidence: Clear naming ($lockedQueue, $restrictToNormal, $candidateIds), short explanatory comments (CallNextTicket.php:22-23, 35-36, 63), small localized branching (CallNextTicket.php:68-80), and consistent with a plain invokable action; no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Diff contains only the action, enum, exception and the two docs the task explicitly asks to update (task.md:50-51); no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: The change adds substantial new behavior with no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule that every feature ships with a test.
The new action and enum are not recorded under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md as the 'keep docs in sync' convention requires.
The public __invoke method has no PHPDoc describing its parameters, return and thrown exceptions, though the conventions ask for PHPDoc on touched public methods.

Using firstOrFail() on the locked queue means a deleted queue throws ModelNotFoundException rather than the domain InactiveQueueException; the task only specifies inactive queues, so this is an unspecified edge case.

review.summary: The change implements CallMode, NoWaitingTicketsException and the CallNextTicket action with the required ordering, mode filters, fairness streak, inactive-queue check and lock-and-recheck exactly-once logic, and updates both requested docs. It is clean and well scoped, but it ships with no tests at all, which the project's conventions treat as mandatory, and it misses the CHANGELOG entry.
